author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the `ticl_v6` process modifier and two upgrade workflows that use it:

- .207: the full workflow with `--procModifiers ticl_v6` in the DIGI and HLT step (step 2), the offline reconstruction (step 3) and the harvesting (step 4). It applies to the TTbar_14TeV, CloseByP, Eta1p7_2p7 and ZEE_14 fragments of the Run4 workflows, as workflow .211 does.
- .532: the HGCAL-only workflow .531 (TTbar_14TeV, Run4) with `--procModifiers ticl_v6` in steps 2, 3 and 4. It reconstructs only HGCAL, so it is a fast test of the TICL changes.

In this PR the modifier does not change any module. The next TICLv6 PRs (see #52567) put their parts under `ticl_v6`, at the HLT and offline, so the PR tests can run each part with workflow 29634.207 or 29634.532 (TTbar, D110). Without the modifier, the reconstruction does not change.

#### PR validation:

- `runTheMatrix.py -w upgrade -n` lists 544 workflows .207 and 34 workflows .532. Steps 2, 3 and 4 of 29634.207 and of 29634.532 have `--procModifiers ticl_v6`.
- The step 2 and step 3 configurations of 29634.207 give the same `process.dumpPython()` output as those of 29634.0.
- The step 2, 3 and 4 configurations of 29634.532 give the same `process.dumpPython()` output as those of 29634.531.
